meta.name: deployment-pipeline-design
meta.description: Design multi-stage CI/CD pipelines with approval gates, security checks, and deployment orchestration. Use this skill when designing zero-downtime deployment pipelines, implementing canary rollout strategies, setting up multi-environment promotion workflows, or debugging failed deployment gates in CI/CD.

copy.tagline: 设计可回滚、带安全审批的发布流水线
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的团队需要规划安全、零停机的软件发布流程
copy.tagline_en: Design gated, rollback-ready release pipelines for zero-downtime deployment
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team needs to design secure, zero-downtime multi-environment release workflows

howto.what: 当你请它设计或排查软件上线流程时，它会按多阶段流水线来给方案：包含自动安全扫描、人工审批、金丝雀式小范围放量、健康检查和回滚预案；若发布门禁卡住，它会帮你分析原因。
howto.when: 当你想设计或排查多阶段部署流水线（例如零停机、金丝雀、多环境推广）的问题时。

say.text: 帮我设计一个先小范围试运行、有人工审批的上线流程
say.note: 它会给出分阶段配置和审批门设置

say.text: 为什么我的金丝雀发布一直停在一半不往前推？
say.note: 按排障指南检查指标和门禁配置

say.text: 把发布流程拆成测试、预发、生产三个阶段，每阶段自动检查后再放行
say.note: 会返回多环境流水线和门控方案

howto.what_en: When asked to design or troubleshoot a software rollout, it plans a multi-stage pipeline with automated security scan, manual approval, canary-style gradual rollout, health checks, and rollback; if a deployment gate stalls, it analyzes why.
howto.when_en: When you want to design or troubleshoot a multi-stage deployment pipeline, e.g., zero-downtime, canary, or multi-environment rollout.

say_en.text: Design a rollout with a small canary group first and a manual approval step.
say_en.note: It will provide stage config and approval gate settings.

say_en.text: Why is my canary rollout stuck halfway and not progressing?
say_en.note: Checks metrics and gate settings per the troubleshooting guide.

say_en.text: Split the release into test, staging, and production, with automated checks before each promotion.
say_en.note: Returns multi-environment pipeline and gate plan.
